definition: A rule that defines the criteria used to identify potential duplicate records, such as matching on name and email.
distractorDefinitions: A rule that decides whether a duplicate is blocked or only produces a warning.
A rule that prevents a record from being saved if a formula condition is not met.
A rule that automatically assigns new leads to the correct owner.
germanExplanation: Definiert die Kriterien, nach denen mögliche Duplikate erkannt werden, z. B. Übereinstimmung bei Name und E-Mail.

definition: A field created directly in a report that groups values into custom categories without changing the underlying data.
distractorDefinitions: A field on the parent object that sums values from related child records.
A field that references a record on a different object.
A field type used to store large text values.
germanExplanation: Ein im Report selbst erstelltes Feld, das Werte in eigene Kategorien gruppiert, ohne die zugrundeliegenden Daten zu verändern.

definition: A named collection of users, roles, or other groups that can be used as a target for sharing rules.
distractorDefinitions: A hierarchical structure that defines which manager can see which subordinate's records.
The baseline access level applied to a record before any sharing is added.
A set of permissions that can be layered on top of a user's profile.
germanExplanation: Eine benannte Sammlung von Nutzern, Rollen oder anderen Gruppen, die als Ziel für Sharing Rules genutzt werden kann.

definition: A bundle of multiple permission sets that can be assigned to a user in a single step, with the option to mute specific permissions.
distractorDefinitions: A single permission set assigned to exactly one user.
A profile that defines the baseline object and field access for a user.
A hierarchy of roles that controls record-level visibility.
germanExplanation: Bündelt mehrere Permission Sets, die in einem Schritt zugewiesen werden können; einzelne Berechtigungen lassen sich dabei gezielt stummschalten (muten).

definition: A custom object with two master-detail relationships that connects two other objects in a many-to-many relationship.
distractorDefinitions: An object that loosely references another object without affecting its security.
A field that automatically sums related child record values.
A layout that controls which fields are visible to which profile.
germanExplanation: Ein Custom Object mit zwei Master-Detail-Beziehungen, das zwei andere Objekte in einer Many-to-Many-Beziehung verbindet.

definition: A visual tool that lets administrators view and create objects, fields, and relationships on a drag-and-drop canvas.
distractorDefinitions: A tool that visually assembles screens, flows, and business logic for automation.
A tool used to design page layouts for a specific record type.
A tool that imports large volumes of records from a CSV file.
germanExplanation: Visuelles Werkzeug, mit dem Objekte, Felder und Beziehungen auf einer Drag-and-Drop-Oberfläche betrachtet und erstellt werden können.

definition: A flow type that displays one or more screens to collect input from a user during the automation.
distractorDefinitions: A flow type that runs automatically in the background when a record is created or updated.
A flow type that can only be launched from Apex or another flow, never directly by a user.
A legacy automation tool that has been officially retired.
germanExplanation: Flow-Typ, der eine oder mehrere Bildschirmmasken anzeigt, um während der Automatisierung Eingaben von einem Nutzer zu erfassen.

definition: A feature that automatically ranks leads by likelihood to convert, based on defined criteria or AI predictions.
distractorDefinitions: A process that automatically turns a qualified lead into an account and contact.
A rule that automatically assigns new leads to the correct sales rep.
A guided, step-by-step visual path shown on the opportunity record.
germanExplanation: Bewertet Leads automatisch nach ihrer Konversionswahrscheinlichkeit, basierend auf definierten Kriterien oder KI-Prognosen.

definition: A set of status values and stages that a case moves through, which can differ by case record type.
distractorDefinitions: A rule that automatically routes a case to the correct queue based on criteria.
A rule that reassigns or escalates a case after a defined time limit.
An automated email sent to a customer immediately after a case is created.
germanExplanation: Eine Abfolge von Status-Werten und Phasen, die ein Case durchläuft; kann je nach Case-Record-Type unterschiedlich sein.

definition: The official Salesforce app that gives users access to records, Lightning pages, and notifications from a phone or tablet.
distractorDefinitions: A marketplace for installing third-party apps built by other companies.
A collaboration feature for group discussions and file sharing.
A tool for building custom pages using drag-and-drop components.
germanExplanation: Offizielle Salesforce-App, mit der Nutzer von Smartphone oder Tablet aus auf Datensätze, Lightning-Seiten und Benachrichtigungen zugreifen.

definition: An online community where Salesforce users, admins, and developers connect, ask questions, and share knowledge.
distractorDefinitions: Salesforce's free official learning platform with modules and hands-on challenges.
The marketplace where third-party apps for Salesforce are listed.
The product family focused on managing sales pipelines and opportunities.
germanExplanation: Online-Community, in der sich Salesforce-Nutzer, Admins und Entwickler vernetzen, Fragen stellen und Wissen teilen.

definition: The Salesforce product family focused on managing leads, opportunities, and the sales pipeline.
distractorDefinitions: The Salesforce product family focused on customer support and case management.
Salesforce's vision of one unified view of the customer across departments.
The category of software used to manage customer relationships in general.
germanExplanation: Salesforce-Produktfamilie mit Fokus auf Leads, Opportunities und die Vertriebspipeline.

definition: An area where an individual user can update their own profile details, such as email, language, and notifications.
distractorDefinitions: The central admin area where the whole organization is configured.
A grid that lets a user quickly switch between different Salesforce apps.
A search bar that finds records across all objects at once.
germanExplanation: Bereich, in dem ein einzelner Nutzer seine eigenen Profildaten anpassen kann, z. B. E-Mail, Sprache und Benachrichtigungen.

definition: An object that comes pre-built with Salesforce, such as Account, Contact, or Opportunity.
distractorDefinitions: An object created by an organization to store data not covered by pre-built objects.
A layout that controls which fields appear on a record page.
A rule that automatically assigns records to the correct owner.
germanExplanation: Ein bereits von Salesforce mitgeliefertes Objekt, z. B. Account, Contact oder Opportunity.

definition: The layout style of a report, such as tabular, summary, matrix, or joined, which determines how rows and groupings are displayed.
distractorDefinitions: A small visual element inside a dashboard, such as a chart or gauge.
The object and field selection available when building a report.
A folder used to organize and set sharing access for reports.
germanExplanation: Bestimmt die Darstellungsform eines Reports (tabellarisch, zusammenfassend, Matrix, verbunden) und damit, wie Zeilen und Gruppierungen angezeigt werden.

definition: A Salesforce product focused on customer support, including Cases, Knowledge articles, and omni-channel routing.
distractorDefinitions: A Salesforce product focused on managing the sales pipeline, from Lead to closed Opportunity.
A free online learning platform with guided modules and hands-on challenges.
A marketplace for installing third-party apps built on the Salesforce platform.
germanExplanation: Ein Salesforce-Produkt mit Fokus auf Kundenservice, u. a. mit Cases, Knowledge-Artikeln und Omni-Channel-Routing.

definition: A free, full-featured Salesforce org used for hands-on learning and practice, separate from any production environment.
distractorDefinitions: A paid sandbox environment used to test changes before deploying them to production.
The official Salesforce online marketplace for third-party apps.
A section of Trailhead that tracks a learner's earned badges and points.
germanExplanation: Eine kostenlose, voll funktionsfähige Salesforce-Org zum praktischen Üben, getrennt von jeder produktiven Umgebung.

definition: A footer bar in Lightning Experience that gives quick access to tools like a phone dialer, notes, or recent records without leaving the current page.
distractorDefinitions: The top navigation bar that lists an app's main tabs, such as Accounts or Opportunities.
The search field at the very top of every Lightning Experience page.
The area in Setup where administrators manage users and their profiles.
germanExplanation: Eine Fußleiste in Lightning Experience mit Schnellzugriff auf Werkzeuge wie Telefonwähler, Notizen oder zuletzt genutzte Datensätze, ohne die aktuelle Seite zu verlassen.

definition: A field that creates a loose relationship between two objects, linking a record to another record without requiring it.
distractorDefinitions: A field that stores free text without any connection to another object.
A relationship where deleting the parent record automatically deletes all related child records.
A field that automatically calculates a value based on other fields on the same record.
germanExplanation: Ein Feld, das eine lose Verbindung zwischen zwei Objekten herstellt und einen Datensatz mit einem anderen verknüpft, ohne diese Verknüpfung zwingend zu machen.

definition: A single chart, table, or metric placed on a dashboard, based on the data from one underlying report.
distractorDefinitions: The saved folder location where a dashboard is stored and shared.
A field within a report that groups values into custom ranges.
The automatic email sent to a user whenever a dashboard refreshes.
germanExplanation: Ein einzelnes Diagramm, eine Tabelle oder eine Kennzahl auf einem Dashboard, basierend auf den Daten eines zugrundeliegenden Reports.

definition: A feature that automatically emails a report to a user on a defined schedule, such as every Monday morning.
distractorDefinitions: A dashboard setting that refreshes its data automatically every time it is opened.
A rule that blocks a report from running if it would return too many records.
A folder setting that controls which users can edit a shared report.
germanExplanation: Eine Funktion, die einen Report automatisch nach einem festgelegten Zeitplan per E-Mail versendet, z. B. jeden Montagmorgen.

definition: A Flow that runs automatically in the background whenever a record is created, updated, or deleted, without any user interaction.
distractorDefinitions: A Flow that displays a series of screens for a user to fill in manually.
A Flow that only runs when a user clicks a button on a record page.
A Flow that can only be started by another Flow, never by a record change.
germanExplanation: Ein Flow, der automatisch im Hintergrund läuft, sobald ein Datensatz erstellt, geändert oder gelöscht wird — ganz ohne Nutzerinteraktion.

definition: A guided, visual set of stages shown at the top of a record, such as Opportunity, that highlights key fields and best practices for the current stage.
distractorDefinitions: A rule that automatically ranks leads by their likelihood to convert.
A feature that shows how much credit a marketing campaign gets for a won deal.
A report that projects expected revenue based on open opportunities.
germanExplanation: Eine geführte, visuelle Abfolge von Phasen oben auf einem Datensatz wie Opportunity, die wichtige Felder und Best Practices für die aktuelle Phase hervorhebt.

definition: A feature that automatically creates a new Lead record in Salesforce whenever a visitor submits a form on the company's public website.
distractorDefinitions: A rule that assigns existing leads to the correct sales rep based on criteria.
A feature that scores leads automatically using AI predictions.
A process that converts a qualified lead into an account and contact.
germanExplanation: Erzeugt automatisch einen neuen Lead-Datensatz in Salesforce, sobald ein Besucher ein Formular auf der öffentlichen Unternehmenswebsite ausfüllt.

definition: A timeline of milestones, such as first response or resolution deadlines, that tracks the customer service level a case is entitled to.
distractorDefinitions: A rule that automatically reassigns a case after a fixed time limit.
A sequence of case status values that a case moves through.
An automated email confirming that a case was received.
germanExplanation: Ein Zeitplan aus Meilensteinen wie Erstantwort- oder Lösungsfristen, der den Service-Level nachverfolgt, auf den ein Case Anspruch hat.

definition: A predefined set of users with specific roles and access levels who collaborate on a single case, such as a support agent and a specialist.
distractorDefinitions: A queue where unassigned cases wait for the next available agent.
A group of users used only as a target for sharing rules.
A report that lists all open cases for a team.
germanExplanation: Eine vordefinierte Gruppe von Nutzern mit festgelegten Rollen und Zugriffsrechten, die gemeinsam an einem einzelnen Case arbeiten, z. B. ein Support-Agent und ein Spezialist.

definition: A setting on an object that determines which field changes automatically appear as updates in that record's Chatter feed.
distractorDefinitions: A private discussion group limited to selected users.
A setting that controls who can see a record based on ownership.
A tool for building custom pages using drag-and-drop components.
germanExplanation: Eine Objekteinstellung, die festlegt, welche Feldänderungen automatisch als Updates im Chatter-Feed dieses Datensatzes erscheinen.

definition: A collection of tabs and pages, accessible from the App Launcher, built to support a specific team's workflow, such as a Marketing app.
distractorDefinitions: A third-party application installed from the AppExchange marketplace.
A page built with drag-and-drop components for a single record type.
A permission set granting access to specific objects.
germanExplanation: Eine Sammlung von Tabs und Seiten, erreichbar über den App Launcher, die für den Workflow eines bestimmten Teams gebaut wird, z. B. eine Marketing-App.

definition: A condensed set of key fields shown at the top of a record or on a mobile card, separate from the full page layout.
distractorDefinitions: The complete set of fields, related lists, and buttons on a record's detail page.
A feature that automatically calculates a value from other fields.
A relationship type where the child record cannot exist without the parent.
germanExplanation: Eine verkürzte Auswahl wichtiger Felder oben auf einem Datensatz oder auf einer mobilen Karte, unabhängig vom vollständigen Page Layout.

definition: A Flow Builder element that splits the flow into different paths based on defined conditions, similar to an if/else branch.
distractorDefinitions: A Flow element that pauses execution and waits for a defined event.
A Flow element that displays a screen for user input.
A Flow element that creates a new record in Salesforce.
germanExplanation: Ein Flow-Builder-Element, das den Flow anhand definierter Bedingungen in unterschiedliche Pfade aufteilt, ähnlich einer if/else-Verzweigung.

definition: In Agentforce, a specific task the agent can perform, such as looking up an order or creating a case, usually connected to a Flow or Apex.
distractorDefinitions: A topic that groups related instructions around one job the agent can do.
The tool used to write and test an agent's response wording.
The security profile assigned to the agent's underlying user.
germanExplanation: In Agentforce eine konkrete Aufgabe, die der Agent ausführen kann, z. B. eine Bestellung nachschlagen oder einen Case anlegen, meist verbunden mit einem Flow oder Apex.

definition: A short alert, shown via the bell icon, that informs a user about relevant activity, such as being mentioned in Chatter or assigned a task.
distractorDefinitions: A saved, filtered list of records from a single object.
A footer bar with quick access to tools like a phone dialer.
A search bar that finds records across multiple objects at once.
germanExplanation: Ein kurzer Hinweis über das Glockensymbol, der Nutzer über relevante Aktivitäten informiert, z. B. eine Erwähnung in Chatter oder eine zugewiesene Aufgabe.

definition: A standard object representing an individual person, typically linked to the Account they work for.
distractorDefinitions: A standard object representing a company or organization.
A standard object representing a potential sale a team is tracking.
A standard object representing an unqualified person or company that has shown interest.
germanExplanation: Ein Standardobjekt, das eine einzelne Person repräsentiert, typischerweise verknüpft mit dem Account, für den sie arbeitet.

definition: A report format that groups records by both rows and columns at the same time, useful for comparing two dimensions, such as region and product.
distractorDefinitions: A report format that lists records as a simple, ungrouped table.
A report format that groups records along one dimension only, with subtotals.
A report format that combines multiple report types with different views on one page.
germanExplanation: Ein Report-Format, das Datensätze gleichzeitig nach Zeilen und Spalten gruppiert — nützlich, um zwei Dimensionen wie Region und Produkt zu vergleichen.

definition: The area in Setup that stores organization-wide details such as company name, address, fiscal year, default locale, and default time zone.
distractorDefinitions: A record of the days and times when support agents are considered available for case handling.
A setting that lets an organization operate with more than one currency at the same time.
A license type that determines which standard features and objects a user can access.
germanExplanation: Bereich in Setup, in dem organisationsweite Angaben wie Firmenname, Adresse, Geschäftsjahr, Standardsprache und Zeitzone hinterlegt sind.

definition: The 12-month accounting period an organization uses for reporting and forecasting, which can follow the standard calendar or a custom pattern.
distractorDefinitions: A record of the days and times when support agents are considered available for case handling.
The setting that lets an organization operate with more than one currency at the same time.
The area in Setup that stores an organization's default locale, address, and time zone.
germanExplanation: Das 12-Monats-Abrechnungszeitraum, den eine Organisation für Reporting und Forecasting nutzt; kann dem Standardkalender folgen oder individuell definiert sein.

definition: A defined schedule of days and times, often per time zone, used to calculate entitlements, case escalation, and support process timing.
distractorDefinitions: The 12-month accounting period an organization uses for financial reporting.
A timeline of milestones that tracks the service level a case is entitled to.
A rule that automatically reassigns a case after it has not been resolved within a time limit.
germanExplanation: Ein festgelegter Zeitplan aus Tagen und Uhrzeiten, oft je Zeitzone, der für Entitlements, Case-Eskalation und Support-Prozesszeiten genutzt wird.

definition: A setting that lets an organization enable multiple currencies, define conversion rates, and let users enter amounts in different currencies.
distractorDefinitions: The 12-month accounting period an organization uses for reporting and forecasting.
The area in Setup that stores an organization's default locale, address, and time zone.
A license type that determines which standard features a user profile can access.
germanExplanation: Ermöglicht einer Organisation, mehrere Währungen zu aktivieren, Umrechnungskurse festzulegen und Beträge in verschiedenen Währungen zu erfassen.

definition: A license assigned to every user that determines the baseline set of features and standard objects available to them, such as Salesforce or Platform license.
distractorDefinitions: An optional add-on license that unlocks one specific feature, independent of the base license.
A named collection of object, field, and system permissions assigned to exactly one user as their base access.
A record of every configuration change made in Setup, including who made it and when.
germanExplanation: Jedem Nutzer zugewiesene Lizenz, die den grundlegenden Funktions- und Objektumfang festlegt, z. B. Salesforce- oder Platform-Lizenz.

definition: Setup options that control session security behavior, such as session timeout duration, session locking to the IP address, and clickjack protection.
distractorDefinitions: A log that records configuration changes made by administrators in Setup, including who made the change and when.
A defined window of days and times during which a user is allowed to log in to Salesforce.
A process that requires users to confirm their identity with an extra verification step during login.
germanExplanation: Setup-Optionen, die das Sitzungsverhalten steuern, z. B. Session-Timeout, Bindung der Sitzung an die IP-Adresse und Clickjack-Schutz.

definition: A log that tracks recent configuration changes made in Setup, including which administrator made the change and when.
distractorDefinitions: Setup options that control how long a user session stays active before it times out.
A defined window of days and times during which a user is permitted to log in.
A rule that defines which second verification factor a user must provide during login.
germanExplanation: Ein Protokoll, das kürzlich vorgenommene Konfigurationsänderungen in Setup nachverfolgt, inklusive Administrator und Zeitpunkt.

definition: A container in Salesforce that defines the structure for storing a particular type of information, made up of fields, and whose instances are called records.
distractorDefinitions: A single piece of information stored on a record, such as a name or date.
One specific instance of data stored within an object, such as one customer's Account.
A visual tool that lets administrators view and create objects, fields, and relationships on a canvas.
germanExplanation: Ein Container in Salesforce, der die Struktur für einen bestimmten Datentyp festlegt, besteht aus Feldern; einzelne Instanzen heißen Records.

definition: A button, configurable on a page layout, that lets a user quickly create a record, log a call, or update a record without navigating away from the current page.
distractorDefinitions: A button available almost anywhere in Salesforce, not tied to a specific record's page layout, used to create a record or log a call.
A condensed set of key fields shown at the top of a record or on a mobile card.
The complete set of fields, related lists, and buttons on a record's detail page.
germanExplanation: Ein auf einem Page Layout konfigurierbarer Button, mit dem ein Nutzer schnell einen Datensatz anlegen oder aktualisieren kann, ohne die Seite zu verlassen.

definition: A formula field that references and calculates a value using fields from a related object, such as pulling a field from a parent Account onto a child record.
distractorDefinitions: A field on the parent object that automatically sums, counts, or averages values from related child records on a master-detail relationship.
A field that creates a loose relationship between two objects without requiring the link.
A field created directly in a report that groups values into custom categories.
germanExplanation: Ein Formelfeld, das Werte aus Feldern eines verknüpften Objekts referenziert und berechnet, z. B. ein Feld vom übergeordneten Account auf einem Kind-Datensatz.

definition: A relationship between two picklist fields where the available values in one field, the dependent picklist, change based on the value selected in another field, the controlling field.
distractorDefinitions: A rule that lets different business processes and picklist values apply to the same object based on record type.
A formula field that calculates a value using fields from a related object.
A field that stores a value chosen from a predefined list, with no relationship to other fields.
germanExplanation: Eine Beziehung zwischen zwei Auswahllistenfeldern, bei der die verfügbaren Werte im abhängigen Feld vom gewählten Wert des steuernden Felds abhängen.

definition: A defined set of picklist values, such as sales stages or lead statuses, that can be assigned to specific record types to reflect different workflows on the same object.
distractorDefinitions: A set of status values and stages that a case moves through, which can differ by case record type.
A guided, visual set of stages shown at the top of a record that highlights key fields for the current stage.
A visual tool that lets administrators view and create objects, fields, and relationships on a canvas.
germanExplanation: Eine festgelegte Menge von Picklist-Werten, z. B. Vertriebsphasen, die bestimmten Record Types zugeordnet werden, um unterschiedliche Abläufe auf demselben Objekt abzubilden.

definition: A page built with the Lightning App Builder for a specific object that arranges components such as related lists, fields, and charts for viewing a record.
distractorDefinitions: A collection of tabs and pages, accessible from the App Launcher, built for a specific team's workflow.
The complete set of fields, related lists, and buttons defined for a record's detail and edit page.
A condensed set of key fields shown at the top of a record or on a mobile card.
germanExplanation: Eine mit dem Lightning App Builder für ein bestimmtes Objekt erstellte Seite, auf der Komponenten wie Related Lists, Felder und Diagramme angeordnet werden.

definition: Security settings, controlled through profiles and permission sets, that determine whether a specific field is visible, editable, or hidden for a given user.
distractorDefinitions: Settings that determine which records a user can see, based on ownership and sharing rules.
The complete set of fields, related lists, and buttons shown on a record's page layout.
A named collection of object, field, and system permissions assigned as a user's baseline access.
germanExplanation: Sicherheitseinstellungen über Profile und Permission Sets, die festlegen, ob ein bestimmtes Feld für einen Nutzer sichtbar, bearbeitbar oder verborgen ist.

definition: An Einstein-powered feature that automatically predicts the likelihood of an open opportunity being won, based on historical data patterns.
distractorDefinitions: A feature that automatically ranks leads by likelihood to convert, based on defined criteria or AI predictions.
A guided, visual set of stages shown at the top of an opportunity that highlights key fields for the current stage.
A feature that shows how much credit one or more marketing campaigns get for a won opportunity.
germanExplanation: Eine Einstein-gestützte Funktion, die automatisch die Gewinnwahrscheinlichkeit einer offenen Opportunity anhand historischer Datenmuster prognostiziert.

definition: A rule that automatically assigns new leads to the correct owner or queue based on criteria such as territory, industry, or lead source.
distractorDefinitions: A process that automatically turns a qualified lead into an account, contact, and optionally an opportunity.
A feature that automatically creates a new lead whenever a visitor submits a form on the company website.
A rule that automatically ranks leads by likelihood to convert.
germanExplanation: Weist neue Leads automatisch anhand von Kriterien wie Gebiet, Branche oder Lead-Quelle dem richtigen Besitzer oder einer Queue zu.

definition: A lead or contact associated with a specific campaign, tracked with a status such as 'Sent' or 'Responded' to measure engagement.
distractorDefinitions: A record that tracks a specific marketing initiative, such as an email newsletter or trade show.
A feature that shows how much credit one or more campaigns get for contributing to a won opportunity.
A person or company that has shown interest but has not yet been qualified as a customer opportunity.
germanExplanation: Ein Lead oder Contact, der einer bestimmten Kampagne zugeordnet ist und mit einem Status wie 'Sent' oder 'Responded' verfolgt wird.

definition: A set of AI-powered features for Sales Cloud, such as opportunity scoring and forecasting insights, that help sales reps prioritize and close deals.
distractorDefinitions: A set of AI-powered features for Service Cloud that help agents resolve cases faster, such as reply recommendations.
Salesforce's platform for building and deploying AI agents that can act autonomously within defined permissions.
A rolled-up projection of expected revenue based on the value and stage of open opportunities.
germanExplanation: Eine Reihe KI-gestützter Funktionen für Sales Cloud, z. B. Opportunity Scoring und Forecasting-Insights, die Vertriebsmitarbeitern helfen zu priorisieren.

definition: A record that links a contact to an opportunity and specifies that contact's role in the deal, such as Decision Maker or Economic Buyer.
distractorDefinitions: A lead or contact associated with a specific campaign, tracked with a status such as 'Sent' or 'Responded'.
A rule that automatically assigns new leads to the correct owner or queue based on criteria.
A guided, visual set of stages shown at the top of a record that highlights key fields for the current stage.
germanExplanation: Verknüpft einen Contact mit einer Opportunity und legt dessen Rolle im Geschäft fest, z. B. Entscheider oder wirtschaftlicher Käufer.

definition: A rule that automatically assigns new cases to the correct owner or queue based on criteria such as case origin, type, or priority.
distractorDefinitions: A rule that automatically reassigns or notifies someone when a case has not been resolved within a time limit.
A timeline of milestones that tracks the customer service level a case is entitled to.
A holding area where unassigned cases wait until a team member picks them up.
germanExplanation: Weist neue Cases automatisch anhand von Kriterien wie Ursprung, Typ oder Priorität dem richtigen Besitzer oder einer Queue zu.

definition: A rule that automatically sends a templated email reply to a customer when they submit a case or lead through a specific channel, such as a web form.
distractorDefinitions: A rule that automatically assigns a new case to the correct owner or queue based on criteria.
A rule that automatically reassigns a case after it has not been resolved within a defined time limit.
A reusable piece of content, such as a how-to guide, that agents or customers can search for while resolving a case.
germanExplanation: Sendet automatisch eine vorlagenbasierte E-Mail-Antwort, sobald ein Kunde über einen bestimmten Kanal, z. B. ein Webformular, einen Case oder Lead einreicht.

definition: A set of AI-powered features for Service Cloud, such as case classification and reply recommendations, that help agents resolve cases faster.
distractorDefinitions: A set of AI-powered features for Sales Cloud that predict which open opportunities are likely to close.
Salesforce's platform for building and deploying AI agents that can act autonomously within defined permissions.
A feature that automatically assigns incoming cases or chats to the best-matched available agent.
germanExplanation: KI-gestützte Funktionen für Service Cloud, z. B. Case-Klassifizierung und Antwortvorschläge, die Agents helfen, Cases schneller zu lösen.

definition: A required step in an entitlement process, such as first response or case resolution, with a target completion time that can trigger alerts if missed.
distractorDefinitions: A timeline that tracks the overall customer service level a case is entitled to.
A rule that automatically reassigns a case after it has not been resolved within a defined time limit.
A set of status values and stages that a case moves through.
germanExplanation: Ein Pflichtschritt innerhalb eines Entitlement Process, z. B. Erstantwort oder Lösung, mit Zielzeit, die bei Überschreitung Alarme auslösen kann.

definition: A holding area for records such as cases or leads that do not yet have an owner, from which team members can accept and work on items.
distractorDefinitions: A named collection of users, roles, or groups used as a target for sharing rules.
A predefined set of users with specific roles who collaborate on a single case.
A rule that automatically assigns new cases to the correct owner based on criteria.
germanExplanation: Sammelbereich für Datensätze wie Cases oder Leads ohne Besitzer, aus dem Teammitglieder Aufgaben übernehmen können.

definition: An activity record representing a to-do item, such as a follow-up call, that can be assigned a due date and owner and linked to a related record.
distractorDefinitions: A calendar-based activity record representing a scheduled meeting or appointment with a start and end time.
A chronological view on a record showing past and upcoming activities and emails in one place.
A short alert shown via the bell icon that informs a user about relevant activity.
germanExplanation: Ein Aktivitätsdatensatz für eine To-do-Aufgabe, z. B. ein Follow-up-Anruf, mit Fälligkeitsdatum, Besitzer und Verknüpfung zu einem Datensatz.

definition: A calendar-based activity record representing a scheduled meeting or appointment, with a defined start and end time.
distractorDefinitions: An activity record representing a to-do item with a due date but no specific start or end time.
A chronological view on a record showing past and upcoming tasks, events, and emails.
A footer bar with quick access to tools like a phone dialer or notes.
